message.content: The t16 probe didn't achieve its intended condition: the 4e-3 gap collapsed to zero under float32 rounding (both 3rd and 4th entries became the identical float 8000000000.0), so the kept-set of 4 is just the "admit all ties" case (num_bad=0). The distinct-gap sub-bracket case remains untested. I'll mark t16 inconclusive for c3 and launch a corrected probe: since any representable distinct gap at scale x is ≥1 ULP (~x·2⁻²³) while the residual bracket is ~range·2⁻⁴⁰, the achievable regime is a 1–4 ULP cutoff gap — that's what the corrected probe should test, across several magnitudes.
